title: AuditRecord
description: A single Control Room audit trail event record

id.description: Unique identifier of the audit record

activityType.description: Category of the audit activity (e.g., USER_LOGIN, BOT_DEPLOY)

createdBy.description: Username of the user who triggered the audited event

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the audited event

detail.description: Detailed description of the audited action

environmentName.description: Name of the Control Room environment

hostName.description: Hostname of the system where the event occurred

objectName.description: Name of the resource object affected by the event

source.description: Source system or interface that triggered the event

status.description: Outcome status of the audited action
